banner.title: cloudflare-dns
banner.tagline: Publishes public hostnames to Cloudflare DNS as proxied records, from HTTPRoutes on envoy-external and DNSEndpoints.

art.about: how a public hostname becomes a proxied DNS record
art.title: How cloudflare-dns publishes public names

explainer.title: From a route on envoy-external to a proxied record

steps.title: Token
steps.text: ExternalSecret cloudflare-dns builds the API token and zone ID for Secret cloudflare-dns-secret from 1Password item cloudflare.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Watch
steps.text: The external-dns controller reads HTTPRoutes attached to envoy-external and DNSEndpoint objects on a one minute interval.
steps.scene: a magnifier over a route map

steps.title: Write
steps.text: It writes proxied records in the lab zone, each with a TXT twin that marks ownership.
steps.scene: a cloud holding a proxied CNAME record card

steps.title: Prune
steps.text: Policy sync deletes the records it owns when their source goes away. Records without a twin are never touched.
steps.scene: a list with one line struck through
